name: Preciousness Of Christ
overview: Scripture reveals the preciousness of Christ through vivid imagery that highlights His unmatched beauty, grace, and excellence. He is portrayed as fairer than all men, blessed by God, and beloved like an apple tree among the woods, offering delight and sweetness. His name is likened to fragrant ointment, and His appearance is described with the richness of fine gold and the purity of doves' eyes, symbolizing His supreme worth and tender care. These descriptions emphasize Christ’s unique role as the cornerstone of grace and the source of spiritual nourishment for His people.
